# AnvilUI

> AnvilUI (`anvilui` on npm) is a React 19 component library with Material 3 styling, built on Base UI. Wrap the app in `AnvilRoot` and import `anvilui/styles.css`. Style props are `fillType` and `color` (not `variant`), icons are Material Symbols name strings, and parts are customized with Base UI's `render` prop (not `asChild`).

The same docs ship inside the package at `node_modules/anvilui/AGENTS.md` and `node_modules/anvilui/docs/`, matching the installed version.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/AGENTS.md): rules, setup, every export, props summary, patterns and common mistakes
- [Full docs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/public/llms-full.txt): all pages in one file

## Guides

- [Setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/setup.md): install, `anvilui/styles.css`, `AnvilRoot`, fonts, Next.js, theme CSS variables
- [Theming and color mode](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/theming.md): AnvilRoot props, color mode, `useAnvil`, `createTheme`, theme roles, design tokens
- [Composition: `render`, refs, className](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/composition.md): `render` instead of `asChild`, refs, className, controlled/uncontrolled props
- [Forms](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/forms.md): building forms, `Field` validation, `FormData`, submit buttons
- [Icons](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/icons.md): Material Symbols names, `Icon`, which props take icon names
- [morph and morphBetween](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/morph.md): `morph()` / `morphBetween()` container transforms

## Buttons and actions

- [Button](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/button.md): Button with `fillType`, `color`, `size`, icons, `loading`, links
- [IconButton](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/icon-button.md): IconButton, icon-only round button (`aria-label` required)
- [SplitButton](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/split-button.md): SplitButton, a segmented group of buttons
- [HoldButton](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/hold-button.md): HoldButton, press-and-hold to confirm destructive actions
- [Toggle](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/toggle.md): Toggle, an on/off button (text or icon)
- [ToggleGroup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/toggle-group.md): ToggleGroup, a segmented control, single or multiple
- [FAB](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/fab.md): FAB, the floating action button
- [FABMenu](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/fab-menu.md): FABMenu, a FAB that opens a stack of actions
- [Chip, FilterChip, InputChip](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/chip.md): Chip, FilterChip, InputChip

## Form controls

- [Input](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/input.md): Input, text field with floating label
- [Textarea](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/textarea.md): Textarea, multi-line text field
- [Field, FieldDescription, FieldError](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/field.md): Field, FieldDescription, FieldError for helper text and validation
- [Select, SelectItem](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/select.md): Select, SelectItem dropdown (`items` for labels)
- [Combobox, ComboboxItem](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/combobox.md): Combobox, ComboboxItem, a filterable picker (render-function children)
- [Search, SearchItem](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/search.md): Search, SearchItem, a search bar with suggestions
- [Checkbox](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/checkbox.md): Checkbox (wrap in `<label>`)
- [Switch](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/switch.md): Switch (wrap in `<label>`)
- [RadioGroup, Radio](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/radio-group.md): RadioGroup, Radio
- [Slider](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/slider.md): Slider, single value or range
- [DateInput](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/date-input.md): DateInput, typed or picked date (`"YYYY-MM-DD"`)
- [TimePicker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/time-picker.md): TimePicker, dial or typed time (`"HH:mm"`)
- [Calendar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/calendar.md): Calendar, a month grid
- [PinInput](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/pin-input.md): PinInput, one box per character for codes

- [PreviewCard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/preview-card.md): PreviewCard, a hover preview for links
- [Tooltip](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/tooltip.md): Tooltip (`label` + one child element)
- [Menu](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/menu.md): Menu, MenuTrigger, MenuPopup, MenuItem, MenuGroup, submenus
- [ContextMenu](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/context-menu.md): ContextMenu, a right-click menu
- [Menubar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/menubar.md): Menubar, a File/Edit/View row of menus
- [useSnackbar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/snackbar.md): `useSnackbar()` toasts
- [useConfetti](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/confetti.md): `useConfetti()` bursts

## Navigation and layout

- [AppBar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/app-bar.md): AppBar, the top bar (`label`, `start`, `end`)
- [NavigationBar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/navigation-bar.md): NavigationBar, bottom navigation for mobile
- [NavigationRail](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/navigation-rail.md): NavigationRail, collapsible side navigation
- [NavigationList](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/navigation-list.md): NavigationList, a text-only sidebar of links
- [NavigationDrawer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/navigation-drawer.md): NavigationDrawer, a slide-in side navigation

- [FloatingToolbar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/floating-toolbar.md): FloatingToolbar, a floating pill of icon buttons

- [List, ListItem](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/list.md): List, ListItem rows with start/end slots
- [Table](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/table.md): Table and its native-element parts
- [Accordion](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/accordion.md): Accordion, expandable sections
- [Carousel](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/carousel.md): Carousel, a horizontal scroller
- [Divider](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/divider.md): Divider, horizontal, vertical or labeled
- [Typography](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/typography.md): Typography `type` and `as`

- [Avatar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/avatar.md): Avatar, image, initials or icon

- [Skeleton](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/skeleton.md): Skeleton loading placeholders
- [Sticker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/sticker.md): Sticker, a tilted decorative label
- [AnimatedNumber](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/animated-number.md): AnimatedNumber, a rolling-digit number
- [Kbd](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itayvak/anvilui/main/core/docs/kbd.md): Kbd, a keyboard key
